### Phase 23: copy-on-write anchored geometry

`active` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase23-cow-geometry/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Replace deep copies of anchored varblock vectors with immutable shared storage and a copy-on-write HfMul retarget overlay. Fresh plans keep owned vectors; anchored probes share unchanged structural decisions and materialize only groups whose quantizer-dependent HfMul values differ. Preserve output bytes, decoder behavior, thread determinism, and the current AnchorReuse semantics.
